result:
- **Cause:** The express shipping commit (`a67da70`) refactored the weight brackets into a table and changed the comparison from `<=` to `<`. A parcel of exactly 5 kg fell into the next bracket (14.90 instead of 7.90); the same was true at exactly 1 kg and 20 kg. This is a real regression, not a flaky test or a runner-02 issue: Xping shows the same error on 3 machines and CI.
- **Action:** In `src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs`, `RateFor` now uses `weightKg <= maxWeightKg` again. I left the test unchanged. All 42 tests pass locally; the fix is not committed or pushed.

One thing may still turn the pipeline red: `Checkout_NumbersInvoicesUniquely_WhenCheckoutsRunInParallel` also failed in the latest Xping run on this commit and is marked known flaky. It is a real race (`_nextInvoiceNumber++` in `CheckoutService.cs` is not thread-safe) and predates this MR, so I did not touch it. The fix is one line with `Interlocked.Increment` — say if you want it in this MR.
